info.name: Ecommerce API - Security Testing
info.description: Security test suite covering Authentication, Authorization, Input Validation, SQL Injection, IDOR, Rate Limiting, and Error Handling. Built for the BATTECHNO Web Security Fundamentals task. Run the whole collection top-to-bottom (folder order matters); the 'Rate Limiting' folder is intentionally last so it doesn't lock out subsequent admin-authenticated requests.

item.name: Get product - non-numeric ID / SQLi attempt (400)
Create product - XSS in description (stored as data)

request.description: Verifies the description is stored as plain text data. The frontend is responsible for output-encoding it when rendering (never inserting it as raw HTML).

item.name: Get another user's data - Customer IDOR blocked (404)

request.description: A logged-in customer must NOT be able to view another user's record by guessing their ID.

item.name: Get any user's data - Admin allowed (200)
Login - rate limit exceeded (429 on 6th attempt)

request.description: Run this request 6+ times in a row (or use Postman Runner with 6 iterations) to trigger the 429 response. Placed in its own folder at the end of the collection so it does not lock out the admin/customer tokens used by earlier requests.
